    MildHyp passes to the opposite category #

    The residue Pᵒᵖ/τ is anti-isomorphic to P/τᵘⁿᵒᵖ (resAntiPair), so their linearizations are anti-isomorphic and representation-finiteness transfers (MildHyp.op). Cancellation swaps sides.

    def LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.resAntiPair {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] {a b : Pᵒᵖ} (τ : a ⟶ b) :
    RayQuiver.AntiPair (Res τ) (Res τ.unop)

    The residue of Pᵒᵖ by τ is anti-isomorphic to the residue of P by τ.unop.
